newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grain markets slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grain markets slightly higher.

text.p: UK physical grain prices were slightly higher on Tuesday, but trade was thin.
Traders said prices were mainly supported by a lack of sellers.
"It seems the farmers have shut up shop for awhile and prices have firmed slightly on this," said a trader.
Delivered grains prices were as much as 1.50 stg a tonne up but the market was thin.
Milling wheat in the Southampton, Tewkesbury, Avonmouth and Gloucester range was fetching 115 stg for Nov and 119 stg for Jan/Mar.
Feed wheat in the Avon four range traded at 99.50 stg for Jan/Mar.
In west Norfolk 96.50 stg was paid for feed barley.
